title: UP Self Enumeration Online Registration 2026 Last Date : 21/05/2026
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UP Self Enumeration portal (as notified by UP Govt)
2. Register with mobile / Aadhaar
3. Fill household / individual details carefully
4. Upload documents if required
5. Submit before 21 May 2026 and save acknowledgement
shortDescription: UP Self Enumeration Online Registration 2026 – last date 21 May 2026. Complete self-enumeration on the official UP portal.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Self Enumeration Online Registration allows citizens to submit their details for the notified enumeration / survey exercise.

Last date: 21 May 2026. Applicants should use only official government links, enter accurate family and identity data, and keep the acknowledgement number safe for future reference.
